name: Ucraft

pricing.free_plan: Free plan on a ucraft.site subdomain, multi-page

tiers.name: Website
tiers.note: entry tier, yearly billing where stated

capabilities: AI site generation and a drag-and-drop editor
limits: Own domain and shop features need a paid plan
run_blocker: The free checkout does not complete: the wizard runs in an iframe on ucraft.com, the login cookie is SameSite=Lax and therefore not sent in that cross-site frame, so the checkout answers 'not authenticated' (17.11.2026). The only other route, My Sites -> Create a new website, leads to a paid Basic Shop checkout (13 $/month, 14-day trial) with no free option.
